Description: This recall involves model year 2017 Can-Am Maverick X3 side-by-side vehicles. The vehicles came in various colors. The model name and Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is printed on a label under the glove box. To verify if your vehicle is included in the recall, have your VIN (Vehicle identification Number) ready and contact your authorized Can-Am side-by-side dealer or BRP. Recalled models include: 2017 Can-Am Maverick X3 STD 2017 Can-Am Maverick X3 XDS 2017 Can-Am Maverick X3 XRS
Title: BRP Recalls Side-by-Side Off-Road Vehicles Due to Loss of Steering Control and Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
ConsumerContact: BRP toll-free at 888-272-9222 from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET Monday through Sunday or online at www.can-am.brp.com and click on "Owner Center" and then "Recall Information" for more information.

Injuries.Name: The firm has received 33 incident reports, including reports of intermittent or complete steering lock. No injuries were reported.

Retailers.Name: Can-Am dealers nationwide from August 2016 through November 2016 for between $23,000 and $27,000.

Importers.Name: BRP U.S. Inc. of Sturtevant, Wis.

Hazards.Name: The steering rack and pinion assembly can have an improper amount of grease and result in a loss of steering control and crash hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact a BRP Can-Am side-by-side dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair. BRP is notifying registered consumers directly about this recall.
